info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts statement details API

items.docs: Extract portfolio statement information from the base64-encoded PDF/image sent in the request. Information is extracted based on the logic defined, where available, for the custodian specified in the `documentShortName` or `documentName` values in the request body.</br></br>The request supports the following file types:</br></br> -JPG </br> -JPEG</br> - PNG </br> - PDF </br></br>When sending a PDF, you can specify the page numbers to extract information from. For example, `1,3,6,9` or `1,3,6,8-1

Get the portfolio statement information extracted by the `POST /statement-details` request. </br></br>The unique job ID returned by the POST request is automatically included in this GET request's URL. 
</br></br>The response contains a JSON obect with an array of security details such as ticker, name, market value, and so on.
